about: What's new, newest first (V3 gap 31). One entry per stage end or notable release, in plain words for a keen amateur. The Help door in More shows these; a dot on Help marks an entry the device has not seen. The chart room thread adds an entry as each stage of handover/design/SSE4-coming-together.md lands.

entries.title: Stage 1: a test drive you can walk
items: Open the Solar System from the start sheet, pick a world and ask why any value is what it is.
Change a world on the Build desk and watch what follows: move Mars to 1 AU and its surface warms by about 50 K. Undo takes it back.
Open any world as a globe, see its magnetic field with Mag, and cut it open with Cutaway.
Play now closes the time ruler in, so you see the days pass.
Go out to the cosmic web from the place line and come straight back down to where you were.
Look up is on the rail at every system and world: elements, substances, constants and units.
Every theme is checked for colour-blind viewers. Element origins, field lines and the accent stay apart for every common colour vision.

entries.title: Where you are, and how to get anywhere
items: The place line along the top shows where you are, from the cosmic web down to a single world. Press any step to go there.
Below, at the end of the line, lists what is inside: the worlds of a system, the systems of a campaign.
Every diagram has the same view controls: zoom and slide everywhere, and tilt and Free where the diagram has depth.
